test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What was the formal name of the Bombay Plan which was published in 1944-45?

options.text: A plan of economic development for India
A plan of industrial development of India
A plan of infrastructure development of India
A plan of strategic development of India

solution:
The correct answer is** __A plan of economic development for India.__**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **The Bombay Plan of 1944 was set up by a group of leading industrialists** in India **for the economic development of the country.**
